about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm a full-stack engineer who ships products end to end — and keeps them reliable in production.
about.journey: My path started at the NTUT Programming Club, where I served as extracurricular president, hosted 12+ knowledge-sharing workshops, and partnered with Google to bring its Machine Learning Crash Course to campus. I then led a 6-person team to ship TAT, NTUT's campus app — 10K+ downloads at 4.3★ — and kept it running through years of breaking portal and authentication changes. That's where I learned to own a product across the whole stack and keep it reliable long after launch.
about.current: Today I work across the stack on cross-platform products — building the front-end, the services behind it, and the cloud infrastructure they run on. I ship continuously: stable 60 fps across 300+ releases, 99% crash-free sessions, and a 1-hour manual build collapsed into a single ~5-second command. I also built and self-host an internal LLM agent (FastAPI, LangChain, Chroma) with a Vue chat UI — a complete full-stack system, backend to UI, guarded by a 40+ contract pytest suite.
about.passion: I like owning the hard middle of a product — where the front-end, the API, and the infrastructure meet. From a custom iOS keyboard powered by an LLM (Swift, SwiftUI) to a Go backend on Cloud Run and a self-hosted RAG agent, I break ambiguous goals into shippable slices, automate the repetitive, debug the deep failures, and make every release decision rest on evidence.
